[[File:Kyoto University RIMS.JPG|thumb|Research Institute for Mathematical Sciences, [[Kyoto University]]]]
The {{nihongo|'''Research Institute for Mathematical Sciences'''|数理解析研究所|Sūri Kaiseki Kenkyūsho|extra='''RIMS'''}} is a research institute attached to [[Kyoto University]], hosting researchers in the [[mathematical sciences]] from all over Japan.  RIMS was founded in April 1963.
